On Sun, Nov 29, 2026 at 09:42 AM Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com> wrote:
> Quick ask for you while we investigate: can you share the browser + version...

Oliver, thanks for the screenshot — I can already see the redirect/referrer header being stripped at the Ariba redirect step. That will drop session cookies on some browsers when the referrer-policy is strict or when a corporate proxy sanitizes headers. Two likely causes:

- Ariba is redirecting through a third-party domain (analytics/marketing) and the browser drops the cookie because referrer is not preserved.
- Rival Components' proxy is rewriting referrer or blocking cross-site cookies.

Short remediation options (we should try both in parallel):
1) Ariba side: ask support to switch the redirect flow to preserve referrer or use a one-step landing on ariba.com (they can disable the intermediary redirect).
2) Client side: Oliver to try incognito + confirm no aggressive proxy. If allowed, temporarily disable any corporate header-stripping appliance for the invite URL.

If those fail, Marissa and I can create a temporary PO via our DocuSign flow so they can receive the first shipment without waiting for portal completion. I'll include a minimal checklist for Marissa to send.

Ben Carter

Hi Priya / Ben / Marissa —

Thanks for the details and the screenshot. We've investigated and found the tenant routing rule included a marketing redirect that sets a referrer-policy of 'no-referrer-when-downgrade' which in some browsers combined with strict proxy header sanitation prevents the referrer from being passed and causes the session cookie drop.

Action taken:
- We disabled the intermediary marketing redirect for the next 24 hours for Redwood Inference invites.
- We also raised a configuration change request to update the invite landing to a direct ariba.com landing page (AR-12233).

Workaround for vendor now:
1) Clear cookies for ariba.com, open private/incognito window.
2) Use the original invite link (we did not change GUID).
3) If that still fails, we can accept a manually-signed PO; please use the DocuSign link below and email a copy to procurement@redwood.com so we can reconcile.

Ticket: AR-12233 — we'll update you when the landing change is live.

Regards,
